Design index rework (src/main.tsx DesignBrowser + styles.css): the level tabs became four index modes. Tree View renders the whole C4 tree always expanded (DesignTree expandAll) with the shown element selected and scrolled into view, followed by a flat "Unconnected artifacts" list of Mermaid diagrams, mockups and Markdown documents that are attached or linked nowhere in the tree. Components lists every Container/Component, UML Artifacts lists every Mermaid diagram and mockup, Documents lists every document with New/Import. The shared index search filters whichever listing is shown, and the state filters still replace the listing.

Markdown integration: DocumentsBrowser.tsx was split into DocumentsIndex (the index mode, now a nav labelled "Design documents") and DocumentWorkspace (the open document). The document renders inside the design panel column (.design-main.document-open) while the index panel and inspector stay visible, so it no longer replaces the workspace. Documents stay reachable from the shown entity through the existing viewer-header link chips and a new "Documents" inspector section for elements and relationships.

Editor fixes (MarkdownEditor.tsx, DocumentEditor.tsx): a document opens on its rendered EasyMDE preview (EasyMDE.togglePreview after mount) and the editor box scrolls. The clip bug was EasyMDE copying maxHeight onto .CodeMirror-scroll as an inline height inside a fixed-height host; maxHeight is no longer forwarded and .CodeMirror-scroll is forced to 100% height with overflow:auto, so a scrollbar appears only when the text is longer than the box, and the document workspace scrolls for everything around the editor.

Acceptance updates: the five native Playwright scripts that encoded the old UI contract (design layout, markdown documents/editor/import/large) now use the index mode tabs, the "Design documents" list, .document-workspace and the document breadcrumb, and the editor scripts leave the new preview default before editing.

Verified: npx tsc --noEmit clean; QA job 249560800 run 2133724378 (build, npm run build) passed; node --check on the edited scripts. Not verified here: the native Playwright/WebView2 suites cannot run on this Linux host, and the GUI was not visually inspected. Committed and pushed as f940a50 on main.

Rework the Adashi desktop design workspace so Markdown design documents are first-class design artefacts inside the design panel instead of a separate replacing panel, and rework the design tree navigation.

Scope
1. Design tree navigation (src/main.tsx DesignBrowser index panel):
   - Rename the "System Context" level tab to "Tree View". It shows the whole C4 tree, always expanded, with the element currently shown in the viewer selected/scrolled into view.
   - After the tree, list all artefacts (UML diagrams and Markdown documents) that are not attached/linked anywhere in the tree, each clickable.
   - Below the "Tree View" button add buttons: Components, UML Artifacts, Documents. Selecting one shows a flat list of all artefacts of that kind instead of the tree.
2. Markdown documents open inside the design panel (main column) while the design index and inspector stay visible; they no longer replace the whole workspace. Documents mode of the index lists the documents with New/Import/find.
3. Markdown documents link to any C4 element (Software System, Container, Component) and appear as clickable links in that element's view (viewer header links already exist; add the linked-document list to the element inspector).
4. Markdown editor fixes: open in Preview by default, and make long content scrollable instead of being clipped.

Acceptance
- `npm run build` (tsc + vite) succeeds with no type errors.
- Manual: selecting a document keeps the design index + inspector; the tree shows Tree View, Components, UML Artifacts, Documents modes; the editor starts in Preview; long documents scroll.

data.title: Integrate Markdown documents into the design panel and rework design tree navigation
